title: Color in layout examples
slide_intent: Show how to adapt campaign layouts to different merchandise and occasions without losing the structure a shopper uses to find the offer and its action.
strategic_value: A repeatable hierarchy lets Instacart present groceries, beauty and a Diwali celebration as distinct stories within one service.
demonstration: Three vertical digital layouts sit together on Kale. Their headline grounds, photographs and messages change while pale surrounds, wordmark positions and green actions recur.
practical_value: Use the grocery, beauty or Diwali example to judge which colors can follow the subject and which elements should remain identifiable.

content_islands.name: Three communications
content_islands.spec: Align the tall samples by their top edge, with a broad dark ground around them. Use a compact wordmark at the head of each.

content_islands.name: Offer hierarchy
content_islands.spec: Within the three samples, group headline and photograph above supporting copy and a green action. Keep each campaign’s imagery and secondary field distinct.
